name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Rostering for Claude Code: the roster ahead and what needs attention, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Needs a decision
sections.note: Worst first. A person rostered past their right-to-work expiry outranks everything.
sections.sql: select reason, label, who, place, detail from v_attention order by rank, days desc nulls last limit 15

sections.title: The next seven days
sections.sql: select to_char(on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, to_char(starts_ts, 'HH24:MI') as starts, to_char(ends_ts, 'HH24:MI') as ends, site, area, coalesce(staff, 'OPEN' || coalesce(': ' || role_needed, '')) as who, state from v_shifts where on_date >= current_date and on_date < current_date + 7 and status <> 'cancelled' order by on_date, site, starts_at

sections.title: Open shifts looking for a person
sections.sql: select ref, to_char(on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, to_char(starts_ts, 'HH24:MI') as starts, to_char(ends_ts, 'HH24:MI') as ends, site, area, coalesce(role_needed, 'any role') as needs from v_open_shifts order by on_date

sections.title: Timesheets awaiting approval
sections.note: Approval is the payroll gate. Late approval is late pay.
sections.sql: select ref, staff, to_char(on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, to_char(clock_in_at, 'HH24:MI') as clock_in, to_char(clock_out_at, 'HH24:MI') as clock_out, break_minutes, round(worked_minutes / 60.0, 2) as worked_hours, state from v_timesheets where status = 'submitted' order by on_date

sections.title: Leave waiting for an answer
sections.sql: select ref, staff, type, to_char(starts_on, 'DD Mon') as from_day, to_char(ends_on, 'DD Mon') as to_day, days, waiting_days, state from v_leave where status = 'requested' order by starts_on

name: hours
title: The hours and the money
subtitle: Rostering for Claude Code: next week costed, worked against rostered, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Next week by person
sections.note: Rostered paid hours and what they cost at each person's rate. Costing only; payroll pays people.
sections.sql: select staff as name, count(*) as shifts, round(sum(paid_minutes) / 60.0, 1) as hours, round(sum(cost_cents) / 100.0, 2) as cost_nzd from v_shifts where status in ('published', 'draft') and staff_id is not null and on_date >= (date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 7 and on_date < (date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 14 group by staff order by sum(paid_minutes) desc

sections.title: Next week by site and area
sections.sql: select site, coalesce(area, '(no area)') as area, count(*) as shifts, count(*) filter (where staff_id is null) as open, round(sum(paid_minutes) / 60.0, 1) as hours, round(sum(cost_cents) / 100.0, 2) as cost_nzd from v_shifts where status in ('published', 'draft') and on_date >= (date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 7 and on_date < (date_trunc('week', current_date))::date + 14 group by site, area order by site, sum(cost_cents) desc nulls last

sections.title: Worked against rostered, last seven days
sections.note: A big plus is unmanaged overtime; a big minus is a service that ran short.
sections.sql: select ref, staff, to_char(on_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, round(worked_minutes / 60.0, 2) as worked_hours, variance_minutes, state from v_timesheets where on_date >= current_date - 7 and clock_out_at is not null order by abs(coalesce(variance_minutes, 0)) desc

sections.title: Rest clashes on the books
sections.note: Two shifts closer together than the rest window.
sections.sql: select staff, first_ref, then_ref, to_char(then_date, 'Dy DD Mon') as day, gap_hours from v_rest_clashes order by then_date
